comments:
Looks like a null `StringSegment`/ `BoundAttributeDescriptor`. Have we seen this before @pranavkm?

Code is here:
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/main/src/Razor/Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.Language/src/TagHelperMatchingConventions.cs#L221-L224

Is there any workaround other than modifying my code ? This literally makes .NET 6 whole SDK completely breaking to existing projects, it's a major catastrophe kind of bug. 

You really should spin a 6.0.1 or something with a fix to this, this is a total showstopper!

Worked around it by using global.json to go back to .net 5 sdk until a new sdk is released.

review_comments: The null ref is here. `Equals(StringSegment)` is null-safe, so using that which also helps remove duplicated code.
